result.description: ALUMICORP PTY LTD  We are seeking a reliable and technically skilled Mechanical Engineering Draftsperson to support the installation, maintenance, troubleshooting and improvement of mechanical systems and machinery in our aluminium manufacturing facility.   The Mechanical Engineering Draftsperson is responsible for preparing, modifying and maintaining detailed engineering drawings, fabrication documentation and technical specifications for aluminium products, systems and structures. The role supports the design, manufacturing, fabrication and installation functions by converting engineering concepts, project requirements and client specifications into accurate technical drawings and production-ready documentation.  The successful candidate will contribute to efficient and safe plant operations by ensuring the mechanical integrity and optimal performance of production equipment.   Benefits  Salary: $80,000 - $85,000 plus Super depending on experience      Task & responsibilities  Engineering Drafting and Design Documentation  •    Prepare detailed mechanical and fabrication drawings using Computer-Aided Design (CAD) software.  •    Produce shop drawings, workshop drawings and manufacturing drawings for aluminium products and systems.  •    Develop detailed component, assembly and installation drawings.  •    Prepare engineering layouts, sections, elevations and construction details.  •    Create three-dimensional (3D) models where required for project coordination and visualisation.  •    Prepare drawing packages for fabrication, procurement and site installation purposes.  •    Modify and revise drawings in response to engineering reviews, client requests or project changes.  •    Maintain drawing registers and revision control systems.  Aluminium Product and System Design Support  •    Assist in the design development of aluminium windows, doors, curtain walls, balustrades, louvres, façades, screens, canopies and other aluminium structures.  •    Prepare fabrication details for aluminium extrusions, brackets, frames, supports and associated hardware.  •    Interpret architectural, structural and engineering drawings and convert them into fabrication-ready documentation.  •    Assist engineers in preparing technical solutions to meet project specifications.  •    Ensure compatibility between aluminium systems and associated materials and components.  Manufacturing and Fabrication Support  •    Prepare cutting schedules, fabrication schedules and production documentation.  •    Develop material take-offs and bill of materials (BOMs).  •    Generate fabrication details to optimise manufacturing efficiency and minimise material wastage.  •    Coordinate with production teams regarding fabrication methods and assembly requirements.  •    Review manufacturing constraints and recommend practical design improvements.  •    Assist with the preparation of CNC machine data and production files where applicable.  •    Ensure fabrication drawings accurately reflect approved engineering designs.  Site and Installation Support  •    Conduct site measurements and verification where required.  •    Assist in preparing as-built drawings and project close-out documentation.  •    Provide technical support to installation teams.  •    Investigate and resolve design discrepancies arising during construction.  •    Attend project sites to confirm dimensions, installation requirements and compliance matters when necessary.  Continuous Improvement  •    Contribute to improvements in drafting standards, drawing templates and documentation systems.  •    Assist in implementing new CAD technologies and drafting methodologies.  •    Recommend improvements to fabrication processes and product designs.  •    Participate in training and professional development activities.      Qualification & experience      Relevant AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma   Minimum of 12 months of relevant industry experience    Work Type:  Full time   Salary:  $80000-85000   Job Publish:  30-06-2026   Job Expire:  30-07-2026   Apply Link:  https://workinitiatives.com.au/job/details?id=5953631   This job is brought to you by workinitiatives.com.au.

result.description:
Placed.au is looking for a full-time Marketing Coordinator for our client in Mulgrave, Victoria. This role is responsible for planning, executing, and managing the company's marketing strategy across brand development, digital marketing, events, partnerships, customer engagement, and e-commerce, while ensuring consistent brand presentation and supporting business growth.

Job Description
Brand & Creative Development

• Manage the company brand identity, ensuring consistency across packaging, point-of-sale materials, promotional assets, and marketing communications.

• Develop marketing collateral including catalogues, lookbooks, brochures, signage, and product information sheets.

• Coordinate product photography and video shoots to ensure visual content aligns with brand values and style.

• Maintain high standards of creative presentation across all digital and printed marketing materials.

Events, Partnerships & PR

• Plan and manage trade shows, pop-up stores, brand activations, and promotional events.

• Coordinate marketing support for wholesale partners, including cooperative advertising and joint campaigns.

• Assist with public relations initiatives, influencer outreach, and strategic collaborations to increase brand awareness.

• Represent the business professionally at external events while maintaining consistent brand messaging.

CRM, Email & Customer Engagement

• Build and manage customer communication campaigns to strengthen customer loyalty and retention.

• Develop automated email marketing campaigns, seasonal newsletters, and promotional communications.

• Analyse customer data to identify trends, segment audiences, and improve customer engagement.

• Support customer experience initiatives to ensure consistent branding across all customer touchpoints.

Digital Marketing & E-Commerce

• Manage and update Shopify website content, including product listings, promotional banners, and campaigns.

• Coordinate social media activity across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn by planning content, managing engagement, and curating posts.

• Manage digital advertising campaigns and monitor performance using Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, SEO, and other marketing tools.

• Prepare regular reports on website, campaign, and social media performance, providing data-driven recommendations for improvement.

Reporting, Administration & General Support

• Maintain the marketing calendar and coordinate project timelines across internal and external stakeholders.

• Monitor marketing budgets, supplier invoices, and campaign expenditure.

• Liaise with external suppliers and internal departments to ensure successful delivery of marketing initiatives.

• Support the sales, retail, and warehouse teams with marketing-related activities and events as required.

Qualifications / Attributes

• Must hold a Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or at least five (5) years of relevant work experience may substitute for the formal qualification.

• Must possess at least one (1) year of relevant work experience in marketing coordination, brand management, or a similar marketing role.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to brand consistency and detail.

• Demonstrated experience coordinating marketing campaigns, events, promotional activities, and marketing collateral.

• Proficiency with Shopify, Klaviyo, Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, and major social media platforms.

• Strong understanding of digital marketing, email marketing, SEO, and e-commerce principles.

• Excellent organisational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret marketing data and recommend improvements.

• Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable working independently in a small business environment.

• Experience with Adobe Creative Suite or Canva, apparel or lifestyle brands, photography, video editing, or B2B marketing will be highly regarded.

Salary Range

$70,000 – $85,000 per annum excluding superannuation.

result.description:
CQ Sawmilling Pty Ltd, established on 1st March 2022, has taken over the family business of S.T. Olive & Sons. With a legacy of approximately 50 years in Dingo, S.T. Olive & Sons have specialized in supplying timber for both underground and open-cut mining industries and structural hardwood to the wholesale and retail sector. The sawmill has a history of providing “Link n Lock” roofing timber props and other specialized mining timbers to mines in Central Queensland—a service that CQ Sawmilling Pty Ltd intends to continue offering.

We recognise the importance of environmental commitments and will adhere to all relevant environmental laws. We strive to minimise the business's impact on the environment and will take all necessary measures to ensure compliance with environmental authority conditions. Our goal is to generate very little waste at the mills, and any waste produced will be treated appropriately before disposal. Most timber by-products, such as sawdust, woodchips, firewood, and side flitches, are sold to garden suppliers or the general public.

We are seeking highly skilled and experienced Mechanical Technicians to join and work with our team.

Your duties will include but are not limited to:
Maintaining and repairing range of mobile and sawmilling equipment
Conduct root cause analysis, fault-finding and diagnosing efficient solutions to machine breakdowns
Troubleshoot mechanical issues
Installs, removes, inspects and repairs mechanical spare parts like bearings, seals on typical mechanical equipment.
Disassembles, assembles, observes, repairs, tests, collects data and prepares reports on equipment, as tasks related to maintenance.
Maintaining non-electrical safety.
Perform routine maintenance on equipment and machines
Ensuring that products meet compliance regulations.
Carry out work instructions as given by Supervisor, work specifications, equipment operation.
Supports improvement projects.
May fabricates and repair metal products and parts by using machine shop tools and equipment.
Controls downtime by performing routine preventative maintenance requirements, daily equipment inspections, and monitoring machine operational performance.
Perform duties consistent with established safety rules and procedures.
Installing and commissioning new equipment as directed.
Communicating with and supporting engineers
Documenting machine safety and maintenance

To be considered for this role, you must have:
Trade Qualifications and +5 years proven relevant experience
Proficiency in diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining mechanical equipment
Strong knowledge of troubleshooting technique and problem-solving skills
Ability to interpret technical manuals, schematics, and diagrams
Excellent attention to detail and a proactive approach to maintenance tasks
Physically fit and able to work in various conditions
Ability to work well both independently and in a team environment
Strong communication skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

Lead enterprise AI strategy, architecture, and delivery across transformative digital initiatives.   Your new company   Join a forward-thinking organisation undergoing a significant digital and data transformation journey. With a strong focus on innovation, emerging technologies, and data-driven decision-making, this organisation is investing in modern AI, analytics, and digital platforms to enhance business outcomes and create long-term value. You will be part of a collaborative environment where technology plays a critical role in shaping future capabilities across the enterprise.    Your new role     
 As the Technical Lead - AI, you will provide both strategic direction and hands-on leadership across enterprise AI, data, analytics, intelligent automation, and digital platform initiatives. Acting as the key link between business stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams, you will drive the design and delivery of scalable, secure, and business-aligned solutions. 
 You will lead the development of enterprise AI and data platforms, define future-state architecture, establish trusted data foundations, and guide the implementation of modern integration and automation capabilities. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will facilitate technical workshops, influence technology roadmaps, and ensure delivery outcomes align with organisational objectives. 
 In addition, you will mentor development teams, promote engineering best practices, and provide governance across solution design, cybersecurity, Responsible AI, and enterprise architecture standards. 
  What you'll need to succeed     
 To be successful in this role, you will demonstrate: 
 
 Proven experience leading complex AI, data, digital transformation, or enterprise technology programs. 
 Strong hands-on expertise in software engineering, solution architecture, and cloud-based platform delivery. 
 Experience designing and implementing AI and data solutions leveraging technologies such as AWS, Snowflake, Cortex AI, Machine Learning, Intelligent Automation, Conversational AI, and Agent-based solutions. 
 Deep understanding of enterprise data architecture, semantic modelling, canonical data structures, API and integration architecture, governance, and security frameworks. 
 Ability to define technology strategy, future-state architecture, and scalable solution roadmaps. 
 Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and business decision-makers. 
 Experience mentoring technical teams and driving high standards of delivery, operational readiness, and continuous improvement. 
 
  What you'll get in return     
 In return, you will have the opportunity to lead enterprise-scale AI and digital transformation initiatives within a progressive and innovation-focused environment. You will play a key role in shaping technology strategy, influencing architectural direction, and delivering solutions that create measurable business impact. 
 You'll benefit from working alongside experienced professionals, exposure to emerging technologies, and the ability to make a lasting contribution to the organisation's future digital capabilities. 
  What you need to do now

The business plays a vital role in supplying high-quality dairy products to local processors and distributors, ensuring sustainability and excellence at every stage of production. With deep roots in Tasmania’s farming community, the business upholds values of integrity, hard work, and commitment to animal welfare.

Through continuous improvement in farming practices and a strong focus on operational efficiency, PA & EJ GEARD has built a reputation for reliable and consistent dairy production. The business is committed to supporting regional development, providing employment opportunities, and maintaining the highest standards of milk quality and herd management.

We are currently seeking a skilled and motivated Dairy Technician to support the efficient management of dairy production activities and livestock performance. The successful candidate will be responsible for assisting in herd management, monitoring animal health and nutrition, maintaining production standards, collecting and analysing farm data, and implementing improved dairy farming practices to maximise productivity and animal welfare.

This is a key position within the organisation and requires a strong understanding of dairy production systems, livestock management practices, and agricultural technologies. The role offers an excellent opportunity to contribute directly to the ongoing success and sustainability of a progressive Tasmanian dairy enterprise.

Qualifications and Experience

-	A Diploma or higher qualification in Agriculture, Dairy Production, Animal Science, Agricultural Technology, or a related field. Three years of relevant experience may substitute for formal qualifications.

-	Experience in collecting, analysing, and maintaining farm production records and livestock data.
-	Sound understanding of workplace health and safety requirements and biosecurity practices in agricultural environments.

-	Analyse milk production and farm outputs to establish and maintain quality standards and production targets.

-	Assist in breeding and herd improvement programs aimed at enhancing milk production, animal health, and genetic performance.

-	Collect, record, and analyse production, breeding, and animal health data to support farm planning and continuous improvement initiatives.
-	Assist in planning and coordinating milking schedules, feed management programs, livestock movements, and other aspects of dairy production operations.
-	Provide advice and recommendations to farm management regarding dairy production techniques, animal husbandry practices, and strategies to improve operational efficiency and sustainability.
-	Ensure compliance with animal welfare, biosecurity, workplace health and safety, and environmental regulations applicable to dairy farming operations.
-	Maintain accurate records relating to herd performance, milk yields, treatments, breeding activities, and farm production outcomes.

Skills and Attributes

-	Strong knowledge of dairy production systems and livestock management practices.
-	Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
-	Ability to interpret production data and implement practical improvements.
-	Good communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively with farm managers, veterinarians, and suppliers.
-	Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities in a dynamic farming environment.
-	Commitment to animal welfare, workplace safety, and continuous improvement.

The Company

At Comunet, we love great tech—but what really drives us is what it makes possible. For 30 years, we’ve been helping organisations get more from their IT, whether that means tightening security, modernising legacy environments, reducing complexity, or setting them up for what’s next. We work with smart people, solve real problems, and build technology that genuinely makes life easier for our clients.? 

We’re big on curiosity, initiative, and people who genuinely enjoy figuring things out. We like teammates who can dive into a technical challenge, collaborate well, share what they know, and still keep things light along the way. Culture matters here, and we invest in it—with a strong Employee Value Proposition, Friday drinks, team events, whole-of-business catchups, and a fully stocked pantry. We work hard, support each other, and make sure there’s room to grow, experiment, and enjoy the ride.? 

We invest in our people through certified and flexible training, flexible work options, and strong support structures. We also believe in promoting from within and take pride in seeing our people grow and succeed. 



About the Role

The Support Engineer role at Comunet is not an entry-level position—it’s for someone who already has solid runs on the board and enjoys getting stuck into complex technical problems. You’ll be a key escalation point within our support team, taking ownership of issues across networking, cloud, security, infrastructure, and more. We’re looking for someone who can work with confidence, think critically, and bring the kind of hands-on experience that helps solve the tougher challenges when they land. 

At its core, this role is about keeping client and internal environments secure, stable, and performing at a high standard—but it also comes with real responsibility. This is a role for someone who can operate with a fair degree of autonomy, make sound technical decisions, and contribute meaningfully across both BAU support and project work. You’ll also help guide graduate and entry-level team members, share your knowledge, and lift the capability of the wider team through experience, mentorship, and technical leadership. 

We operate 6am - 6pm Monday to Friday to service our clients and shifts will fall within these hours on a rotating basis. 

 Applicants must have the legal right to work in Australia on an ongoing basis. 



Key Responsibilities:

Deliver high-quality IT support to our clients, with a strong focus on responsiveness, professionalism, and customer service.

Manage support tickets effectively, ensuring client requests are accurately logged, updated, prioritised, and progressed through to resolution.

Support and administer core IT infrastructure and cloud-based systems, applying strong technical skills across modern business environments. 



 Key technical skills:

Knowledge of basic networking (routing and switching).

2+ years of experience in Microsoft 365 administration (with exposure to hybrid Exchange environments considered highly desirable). 

AWS and/or Azure skills highly desirable. 

Demonstrate a strong knowledge of security practises and controls. 



Attributes we look for:

You’ll bring at least two years of IT experience, along with relevant qualifications or certifications, and be ready to build on your existing knowledge. You’ll enjoy working with clients to solve technical challenges and help deliver stable, secure, and reliable platforms for their business. 



How to Apply

We'd love a cover letter with your CV addressing why you should be the suitable candidate to join us. 

As this is active ongoing recruitment process the position may be filled with the right applicant before the published closing date - so we encourage applications as early as possible.  

By submitting an application to Comunet, you acknowledge that we will undertake workforce screening activities including, but not limited to: Reference checks, National Crime and Right to Work Checks, Identity and certification verification.

Only candidates that are short listed will be contacted.

Quality Assurance Officer position available in all states NSW, Qld, Vic, & WA

At NEPEAN™ we are proud to be Australia’s leading privately owned engineering, mining services and industrial manufacturing organisation. We have unique capabilities to deliver high value, innovative and sustainable solutions for the world’s leading mining, construction, and transport companies. Over the last 40 years, hard work, technical credibility, and a willingness to tackle very difficult projects have earned NEPEAN an enviable reputation. Today our organisation employs over 1400 people across six continents and distributes products to more than 65 countries

We service our customers through multiple businesses in our portfolio: NEPEAN Building and Infrastructure (Galserv, Galintel, Weldlok), NEPEAN Engineering and Innovation, NEPEAN Power, Mining (NEPEAN Longwall), PROK, NEPEAN Conveyors, NEPEAN Transport, Gurtec, Roxon, and NEPEAN Belting Mackay.

The Role
As QA Officer, you are responsible for ensuring that all products and services consistently meet established quality standards and regulatory requirements. This involves performing tests, identifying defects, documentation, and assisting in process improvements.

Your Duties and Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
Conduct routine quality assurance inspections and testing of materials, components to ensure compliance with Australian Standards and ISO 9001 quality requirements
Develop and implement quality control plans (QCP) and inspection test plans (ITP) for mechanical systems, welding, and assembly operations
Maintain, review, and update quality documentation, including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), batch records, and, in some cases, product specifications
Monitor and ensure product quality throughout the production process, following ISO 9001 and industry-specific standards
Investigate product quality issues, identify root causes, and prepare reports on non-conforming materials or processes
Prepare detailed quality documentation including test reports, inspection records, and final dossiers for client handover
Collaborate with design, production, and maintenance teams to resolve quality issues and ensure continuous improvement of products
Ensure testing equipment is properly maintained, calibrated, and used according to protocols
Ensure compliance with Work Health and Safety (WHS) requirements in all QA-related activities
Coordinate third-party inspections and liaise with suppliers to verify conformance of mechanical parts and supplied materials, ensuring they meet company standards
Document quality assurance activities and create audit reports.

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Previous work experience in quality assurance or a similar field.
Working knowledge of tools, methods, and concepts of quality assurance.
Solid knowledge of relevant regulatory standards.
Good communication skills, both verbal and written.
Excellent data collection and analysis skills
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills, with high attention to detail.

If you believe you have the right skills, experience and passion for succeeding in this role, please submit your cover letter and resume for consideration.

NEPEAN believes in diversity and is committed to providing Equal Employment opportunities for all applicants. We welcome applicants from all walks of life which also included various socio-economic, cultural, LGBTIQ, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander backgrounds.

Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

Summary
We are seeking a skilled and dedicated Machine Operator to join our clients team in the steel industry. As a Machine Operator, you will be responsible for operating and maintaining a variety of metalworking machinery to produce high-quality metal products. Your attention to detail, technical expertise, and commitment to safety will play a crucial role in our manufacturing process.
 
Company
Based in Marrickville, our company specializes in the production of a diverse range of metal products, including tables, chairs, trolleys, and other innovative solutions. They pride in their commitment to quality craftsmanship and cutting-edge design.
 
Responsibilities
* Set up and prepare metalworking machines, including lathes, milling machines, grinders, presses, and CNC machines, for production according to specifications.
* Operate machinery to shape, cut, form, or assemble metal components used in the production of a wide range of metal products, including but not limited to Connoisseur Racks, Display Racks, Primat Racks, Strip Racks, Brackets, and Clips, ensuring adherence to quality standards and production schedules.
* Monitor machine operations and conduct regular inspections to verify product accuracy and quality, making adjustments as needed.
* Perform routine maintenance tasks on machines, including cleaning, lubricating, and replacing worn parts to ensure optimal performance.
* Follow safety guidelines and protocols rigorously to maintain a safe working environment and prevent accidents.
* Collaborate with team members, supervisors, and engineers to communicate production updates, issues, and improvements.
* Troubleshoot and resolve operational issues, such as machine malfunctions, material inconsistencies, or quality deviations, to minimize downtime.
* Maintain accurate records of production data, machine settings, maintenance activities, and any encountered issues.
* Continuously seek opportunities for process improvement and efficiency enhancement in machine operation and product quality.
* Adhere to company policies, procedures, and guidelines to maintain a productive and positive work environment.
 
Requirements
* Experience as a Machine Operator in the metal industry, with an understanding of metalworking machinery and techniques (Desirable - Training to be provided by employer)
* Proficiency in operating and troubleshooting various metalworking machines
* Solid mechanical aptitude and technical skills to perform routine maintenance and address minor mechanical issues.
* Attention to detail and precision in following instructions, measurements, and specifications.
* Excellent problem-solving skills to identify issues and implement effective solutions.
* Strong commitment to safety protocols and guidelines.
* Effective communication skills to interact with team members, supervisors, and engineers.
* Physical stamina to stand for extended periods, lift heavy materials, and perform repetitive tasks.
* Flexibility to adapt to changing production demands and learn new techniques or machinery.
* Willingness to engage in ongoing training and professional development.

Warehouse Academy is facilitating recruitment on behalf of our client. The successful applicant will be employed and paid directly by the client. Warehouse Academy is a recruitment coordination service only and is not the employer for this role.
